query: For the paper "How multilingual is Multilingual BERT?" (arXiv: 1906.01502), answer this question: Which languages with different script do they look at?

drafts: 论文考察的不同书写系统语言对包括乌尔都语（阿拉伯字母）与印地语（天城文）[12]，以及英语与日语[8]。但所给证据未完整列举实验中分析的所有不同书写系统语言[12][8]。

requirements.reason: 回答了问题：列出了不同书写系统的语言对（乌尔都语/阿拉伯字母—印地语/天城文；英语—日语），均有本地引文支持。后句还明确承认证据未完整列举所有不同书写系统语言，符合题目仅要求依据所给证据作答的实际情况，缺口已明示。

citations.quote: an M-BERT model that has been ﬁne-tuned using only POS- labeled Urdu (written in Arabic script), achieves 91% accuracy on Hindi (written in Devanagari script)
cross-script transfer is less accurate for other pairs, such as English and Japanese

cited_sources.text: However, cross-script transfer is less accurate for other pairs, such as English and Japanese, indi- cating that M-BERT’s multilingual representation is not able to generalize equally well in all cases. A possible explanation for this, as we will see in section 4.2, is typological similarity. English and Japanese have a different order of subject, verb 5Individual language trends are similar to aggregate plots.

Among the most surprising results, an M-BERT model that has been ﬁne-tuned using only POS- labeled Urdu (written in Arabic script), achieves 91% accuracy on Hindi (written in Devanagari script), even though it has never seen a single POS- tagged Devanagari word. This provides clear ev- idence of M-BERT’s multilingual representation ability, mapping structures onto new vocabularies based on a shared representation induced solely from monolingual language model training data.
